label: راشد — نجدي
ref_text: وإذا فيه تعليمات للموقع مثل بوابة أو رقم شقة، أضفها عشان ما يتعطل الوصول.
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_cs/wavs/najdi_cs_4_najdi_cs_01_clean_010.wav (id najdi_cs_00380, cut from set 4's najdi_cs_01_clean.wav; no najdi_cs clip is in najdi_v4, so the shipped checkpoint never trained on this voice)
notes: The male voice of the synthetic najdi_cs customer-support sets, where the agent calls himself Rashed (set 4), Fahad (set 7) and Khaled (sets 2, 5): one synthesiser voice under several names (speaker similarity 0.89 across its 22 recordings). No model here trained on it; the omnivoice_najdi model only clones it. Picked on 2026-10-01 from 29 candidate segments of 5-9 s. Re-checked on 2026-10-04 with najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250 against the eight best: the best alternative was within noise of this one (similarity +0.013 +/- 0.014, UTMOS -0.080 +/- 0.099), so this clip stays. Of all the voices his accent gains the most from being spoken with ars: P(Gulf) on 20 Najdi lines 0.32 with arb, 0.61 with ars.

language_check.model: najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250, 20 held-out Najdi lines and 20 held-out MSA lines, each code
